title: ISO Lab: MISO market history (DA vs RT, FTR)
description: Day-ahead vs real-time hourly prices and congestion from MISO's daily reports, and monthly FTR auction results (ClickHouse iso).

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Pricing node for the DA vs RT panels (da_lmp_hourly); hubs first.

query.rawSql:
SELECT node FROM da_lmp_hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
  AND interval_start_utc >= (SELECT max(interval_start_utc) FROM da_lmp_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) - INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY node ORDER BY node NOT LIKE '%.HUB', node LIMIT 5000

list.definition:
SELECT node FROM da_lmp_hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
  AND interval_start_utc >= (SELECT max(interval_start_utc) FROM da_lmp_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) - INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY node ORDER BY node NOT LIKE '%.HUB', node LIMIT 5000

list.name: auction
list.label: FTR auction
list.description: Monthly FTR auction (ftr_market_results), newest first; the year before the window is included.

query.rawSql:
SELECT auction FROM ftr_market_results
WHERE start_date >= toStartOfMonth($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AND start_date <= $__toTime
GROUP BY auction ORDER BY min(start_date) DESC LIMIT 100

list.definition:
SELECT auction FROM ftr_market_results
WHERE start_date >= toStartOfMonth($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AND start_date <= $__toTime
GROUP BY auction ORDER BY min(start_date) DESC LIMIT 100

options.content:
**MISO market history, from the daily and monthly report marts** (back-filled: hourly DA/RT LMP and binding
constraints from 2025-01-01, FTR auctions from 2025-01). Times are **UTC interval starts**; "EST" labels are MISO
market time = UTC-5, no DST. **DA - RT** (the "DART" spread) > 0 means day-ahead cleared above real time.
RT hourly is **preliminary** until the final lands ~5 days after the market day (quirk #15; *Coverage* shows
how far final reaches). Report files are keyed by the market date inside them, not the filename (quirk #11).
Shadow prices use MISO's sign (negative = binding cost); congestion totals use |shadow price|.
[All quirks](https://github.com/AlverezYari/iso-market-data-lab/blob/main/docs/miso-quirks.md)

panels.title: DA vs RT hourly LMP at $node
panels.description: da_lmp_hourly and rt_lmp_hourly, hourly, $/MWh (RT: final where settled, else prelim).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start_utc) AS time,
    avgIf(price, src = 'DA') AS "DA LMP", avgIf(price, src = 'RT') AS "RT LMP"
FROM (
    SELECT 'DA' AS src, interval_start_utc, lmp AS price FROM da_lmp_hourly
    WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RT' AS src, interval_start_utc, lmp AS price FROM rt_lmp_hourly
    WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Coverage at $node
panels.description: Newest hour (UTC interval start) in da_lmp_hourly, and in rt_lmp_hourly by settlement: final lags prelim by ~5 days (quirk #15).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    (SELECT max(interval_start_utc) FROM da_lmp_hourly WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) AS "DA through",
    (SELECT maxIf(interval_start_utc, settlement = 'final') FROM rt_lmp_hourly WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) AS "RT final through",
    (SELECT max(interval_start_utc) FROM rt_lmp_hourly WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) AS "RT prelim through"

panels.title: DA - RT spread at $node (daily mean)
panels.description: da_lmp_hourly joined to rt_lmp_hourly on the hour, $/MWh, averaged per UTC day: DA minus RT for the LMP and for its congestion component (MCC). Positive = day-ahead premium.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start_utc) AS time,
    avg(d.lmp - r.lmp) AS "DA - RT (LMP)", avg(d.mcc - r.mcc) AS "DA - RT (congestion)"
FROM (SELECT interval_start_utc, lmp, mcc FROM da_lmp_hourly WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) AS d
INNER JOIN (SELECT interval_start_utc, lmp, mcc FROM rt_lmp_hourly WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) AS r
USING (interval_start_utc)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: DA vs RT congestion component (MCC) at $node
panels.description: da_lmp_hourly.mcc and rt_lmp_hourly.mcc, hourly, $/MWh: whether day-ahead priced the congestion real time saw.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start_utc) AS time,
    avgIf(mcc, src = 'DA') AS "DA MCC", avgIf(mcc, src = 'RT') AS "RT MCC"
FROM (
    SELECT 'DA' AS src, interval_start_utc, mcc FROM da_lmp_hourly
    WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RT' AS src, interval_start_utc, mcc FROM rt_lmp_hourly
    WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: DA - RT spread by hub
panels.description: da_lmp_hourly joined to rt_lmp_hourly on (node, hour), $/MWh, the eight trading hubs, over the window. Mean |DA - RT| is the typical miss either way.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT node AS "Hub",
    round(avg(d.lmp), 2) AS "Mean DA", round(avg(r.lmp), 2) AS "Mean RT",
    round(avg(d.lmp - r.lmp), 2) AS "Mean DA - RT", round(avg(abs(d.lmp - r.lmp)), 2) AS "Mean |DA - RT|",
    round(max(r.lmp), 2) AS "Max RT", count() AS "Hours"
FROM (SELECT node, interval_start_utc, lmp FROM da_lmp_hourly WHERE node LIKE '%.HUB' AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) AS d
INNER JOIN (SELECT node, interval_start_utc, lmp FROM rt_lmp_hourly WHERE node LIKE '%.HUB' AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) AS r
USING (node, interval_start_utc)
GROUP BY node ORDER BY node

panels.title: DA - RT spread at $node by hour of day (EST)
panels.description: da_lmp_hourly joined to rt_lmp_hourly, $/MWh, mean over the window per hour beginning in MISO market time (EST = UTC-5, no DST).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT leftPad(toString(toHour(toTimeZone(interval_start_utc, 'Etc/GMT+5'))), 2, '0') AS "Hour beginning (EST)",
    round(avg(d.lmp - r.lmp), 2) AS "Mean DA - RT"
FROM (SELECT interval_start_utc, lmp FROM da_lmp_hourly WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) AS d
INNER JOIN (SELECT interval_start_utc, lmp FROM rt_lmp_hourly WHERE node = ${node:singlequote} AND $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)) AS r
USING (interval_start_utc)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Congestion: DA vs RT, sum of |shadow price| per day
panels.description: da_binding_constraints (hourly) and rt_binding_constraints (5-min, summed / 12 to hour-equivalents), $/MWh x hours per UTC day, all constraints. A rough congestion-intensity index, not a dollar rent (no flows).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start_utc) AS time,
    sumIf(abs(shadow_price), src = 'DA') AS "DA",
    sumIf(abs(shadow_price), src = 'RT') / 12 AS "RT"
FROM (
    SELECT 'DA' AS src, interval_start_utc, shadow_price FROM da_binding_constraints WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RT' AS src, interval_start_utc, shadow_price FROM rt_binding_constraints WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Binding constraint-hours per day: DA vs RT
panels.description: da_binding_constraints rows (constraint-hours) and rt_binding_constraints rows / 12, per UTC day. RT binding more than DA = day-ahead under-forecast congestion.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start_utc) AS time,
    countIf(src = 'DA') AS "DA", countIf(src = 'RT') / 12 AS "RT"
FROM (
    SELECT 'DA' AS src, interval_start_utc FROM da_binding_constraints WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RT' AS src, interval_start_utc FROM rt_binding_constraints WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc)
)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top constraints: DA vs RT
panels.description: da_binding_constraints and rt_binding_constraints over the window, joined on constraint_id: hours binding and sum of |shadow price| x hours ($/MWh x h; RT 5-min / 12). Ranked by the larger of the two. DA hours = 0: RT-only (not anticipated day-ahead).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT constraint_id AS "ID",
    if(d.name != '', d.name, r.name) AS "Constraint",
    if(d.branch != '', d.branch, r.branch) AS "Monitored branch",
    if(d.contingency != '', d.contingency, r.contingency) AS "Contingency",
    d.hours AS "DA hours", round(d.cost, 0) AS "DA Σ|SP| × h",
    round(r.n / 12, 1) AS "RT hours", round(r.cost / 12, 0) AS "RT Σ|SP| × h"
FROM (
    SELECT constraint_id, any(constraint_name) AS name, any(branch_name) AS branch, any(contingency) AS contingency,
        count() AS hours, sum(abs(shadow_price)) AS cost
    FROM da_binding_constraints WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc) GROUP BY constraint_id
) AS d
FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT constraint_id, any(constraint_name) AS name, any(branch_name) AS branch, any(contingency) AS contingency,
        count() AS n, sum(abs(shadow_price)) AS cost
    FROM rt_binding_constraints WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start_utc) GROUP BY constraint_id
) AS r USING (constraint_id)
ORDER BY greatest(d.cost, r.cost / 12) DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: FTR prompt-month shadow price at each hub (Peak)
panels.description: ftr_source_sink_shadow_prices, one point per monthly auction (x = auction month), $/MW for the prompt-month Peak product (period = auction month). Last 12 months regardless of the time picker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') AS time, source_sink, avg(shadow_price) AS "Shadow price"
FROM ftr_source_sink_shadow_prices
WHERE source_sink LIKE '%.HUB' AND class = 'Peak' AND period = substring(auction, 1, 5)
  AND parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') >= toStartOfMonth($__fromTime) AND parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time, source_sink ORDER BY time

panels.title: FTR awards per auction
panels.description: ftr_market_results, one point per monthly auction (x = auction month, all periods sold in it): cleared MW and auction value (sum of MW x clearing price, $). Last 12 months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') AS time, sum(mw) AS "Cleared MW", sum(mw * clearing_price) AS "Auction value"
FROM ftr_market_results
WHERE parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') >= toStartOfMonth($__fromTime) AND parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Highest-value FTR paths in $auction
panels.description: ftr_market_results for the selected auction: the 20 source -> sink paths with the largest |MW x clearing price|. Clearing price is $/MW for the whole period; negative = the holder was paid to take it (counter-flow).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source AS "Source", sink AS "Sink", period AS "Period", class AS "Class",
    round(sum(mw), 1) AS "Cleared MW", round(sum(mw * clearing_price) / sum(mw), 2) AS "Price ($/MW)",
    round(sum(mw * clearing_price), 0) AS "Value ($)"
FROM ftr_market_results
WHERE auction = ${auction:singlequote}
  AND parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') >= toStartOfMonth($__fromTime) AND parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') <= $__toTime
GROUP BY source, sink, period, class
HAVING sum(mw) > 0
ORDER BY abs(sum(mw * clearing_price)) DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: FTR binding constraints in $auction
panels.description: ftr_binding_constraints for the selected auction: the 20 with the largest |marginal cost| ($/MW), with limit and flow (MW).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT device_name AS "Device", contingency AS "Contingency", period AS "Period", class AS "Class",
    direction AS "Dir", round(limit_mw, 1) AS "Limit MW", round(flow_mw, 1) AS "Flow MW",
    round(marginal_cost, 2) AS "Marginal cost ($/MW)"
FROM ftr_binding_constraints
WHERE auction = ${auction:singlequote}
  AND parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') >= toStartOfMonth($__fromTime) AND parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') <= $__toTime
ORDER BY abs(marginal_cost) DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Hub shadow prices in $auction
panels.description: ftr_source_sink_shadow_prices for the selected auction, eight trading hubs, $/MW per period and class.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT period AS "Period", source_sink AS "Hub",
    round(avgIf(shadow_price, class = 'Peak'), 2) AS "Peak ($/MW)",
    round(avgIf(shadow_price, class = 'Off-peak'), 2) AS "Off-peak ($/MW)"
FROM ftr_source_sink_shadow_prices
WHERE auction = ${auction:singlequote} AND source_sink LIKE '%.HUB'
  AND parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') >= toStartOfMonth($__fromTime) AND parseDateTime(substring(auction, 1, 5), '%b%y') <= $__toTime
GROUP BY period, source_sink ORDER BY period, source_sink
